# Zero-Telemetry Agentic Research Lab

> Confidential AI Toolchains, Local AST Execution, and Token Preservation Engineering

## Published Research Monographs
- [Zero-Telemetry Local Execution in Enterprise Developer Toolchains](zero-telemetry-local-execution-developer-toolchains.html): Why enterprise development teams mandate zero-telemetry local execution scripts to preserve source code privacy while running technical audits.
- [Local Python AST Parsers vs Cloud-Based SaaS Auditing](local-python-ast-parsers-vs-cloud-saas.html): Comparative security and data privacy analysis for enterprise teams.
- [Air-Gapped Compliance Testing for Regulated Industries](air-gapped-compliance-testing-regulated-industries.html): Executing comprehensive search hygiene audits in secure network enclaves.
- [Eliminating Third-Party API Leakage in Code Refactoring](eliminating-third-party-api-leakage-refactoring.html): Best practices for deterministic, localized code transformation.
